page.overview:
Who is Oppo Rancisis?

Oppo Rancisis was a Force-sensitive Thisspiasian male Jedi Master who served on the Jedi Council during the High Republic Era, Invasion of Naboo, and the Clone Wars. He was known to be one of the wisest members of the Council, respected for his quiet wisdom and devotion to the Force. Rancisis was a survivor of the initial Great Jedi Purge.

Oppo Rancisis was born on the rocky temperate world of Thisspias Rancisis joined the Jedi Order as a youngling while still an infant. He became the Padawan learner of Jedi Master Yaddle. At some point, Rancisis was offered the throne of the Blood Monarch, but he declined and chose to continue a life of service as a Jedi instead.

During the High Republic Era, Oppo Rancisis oversaw the construction of a Jedi temple on Falaston. He and his Padawan Dal Azim saved a group of slaves from an attack on a Zygerrian encampment, including the Twi'lek Lourna Dee. Rancisis became fond of Dee after seeing her willingness to put her life on the line for the other captives, and suggested that she enroll in the Carida Military Academy in order to gain skills that would help those in need. Dee reluctantly agreed. Rancisis checked in on Dee and her progress at the academy from time to time, but the two eventually lost touch when Dee abandoned the Academy.

By the year 232 BBY, Rancisis had become a member of the Jedi High Council, the governing body of the Order, and went onto be one of its oldest members.
